newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian rubber co SAPH pays div June 30.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian rubber co SAPH pays div June 30.

text.p: Ivory Coast rubber producer Societe Africaine de Plantations d'Heveas (SAPH) said it would pay an interim dividend of 1,000 CFA francs ($1.7) per share on June 30.
It made the announcement in an advertisement in the official daily Fraternite-Matin.
It also said that turnover rose by two percent in the first half to March 31, 1997, to 13.44 billion CFA francs ($23 million) from 13.18 billion in the same period of 1995/96.
Twenty percent of the company's shares were floated on the Abidjan stock exchange at the start of 1997.
